vadsrijk.z6raid.enrage: The tower is losing its patience!
vadsrijk.z6raid.halster.later: The humpguh stable isn't open yet in this version: keep this halter safe.
vadsrijk.z6raid.klaar.chat: The Star-Snuffing Tower is cleared! Time %s, wipes %s. Your chest is on the roof; the pillar of light in the middle takes you outside.
vadsrijk.z6raid.loot.vleugels: %s got the Star Ring Wings from The Star-Snuffing Tower!
vadsrijk.z6raid.rij.beurt: It's your turn! Come to The Waiting Hall within 10 seconds.
vadsrijk.z6raid.rij.erin: The tower is occupied. You're in the queue: spot %s.
vadsrijk.z6raid.ringeling.al_scherf: You're already carrying a star shard.
vadsrijk.z6raid.ringeling.fase2: The Empty Lens is sucking up the light
vadsrijk.z6raid.ringeling.geen_ringen: She has no more rings to kick!
vadsrijk.z6raid.ringeling.lens: The Lens protects her: light all the beacons first!
vadsrijk.z6raid.ringeling.onder: the Ring Finger, with ten rings on her toes
vadsrijk.z6raid.ringeling.ring_komt: A %s is coming at you: JUMP into the pink circle to catch it!
vadsrijk.z6raid.ringeling.scherf_op: You're carrying a star shard: take it to a snuffed beacon!
vadsrijk.z6raid.ringeling.zeg.dans: Will you dance with me? My rings are bigger than you!
vadsrijk.z6raid.ringeling.zeg.einde1: My... toes... Nobody ever asked whether I was happy.
vadsrijk.z6raid.ringeling.zeg.einde2: Look... the stars. They're burning again. I'd forgotten how beautiful they are.
vadsrijk.z6raid.ringeling.zeg.einde3: The Emperor won't get another ring from me. I'll help you, knights. Come and visit me in Saffron Gate!
vadsrijk.z6raid.ringeling.zeg.lens: Lens, drink the light! Everything, everything, EVERYTHING for the Emperor!
vadsrijk.z6raid.ringeling.zeg.licht: No! My darkness! Who goes around lighting stars in here?
vadsrijk.z6raid.spiegelvizier.draai: The mirror now points at image %s of %s.
vadsrijk.z6raid.spiegelvizier.fout: Wrong image! A mirror clone steps out.
vadsrijk.z6raid.spiegelvizier.gewisseld: Who's who? You swapped places with %s!
vadsrijk.z6raid.spiegelvizier.immuun: That's just a reflection... or he's still hiding.
vadsrijk.z6raid.spiegelvizier.nep: Fake! A mirror clone steps out.
vadsrijk.z6raid.spiegelvizier.onder: Master Gleam, mirror polisher and illusionist
vadsrijk.z6raid.spiegelvizier.zeg.breekt: My mirrors! Do you know how long I spent polishing those?
vadsrijk.z6raid.spiegelvizier.zeg.versto: Guess which one I am. I polish myself so shiny, you'll never tell the difference!
vadsrijk.z6raid.start.alleen: The tower won't let you in alone: bring at least one friend (2-10 players).
vadsrijk.z6raid.start.onder: %s players. Four floors, four bosses. Go get 'em!
vadsrijk.z6raid.start.tel: Stay put... %s players on the start circle.
vadsrijk.z6raid.sterrenbeelden.aangestok: Too late: they light each other up again!
vadsrijk.z6raid.sterrenbeelden.brul: Bear Roar! Get IN, close to the Snuggle!
vadsrijk.z6raid.sterrenbeelden.klem: Snuggle Squeeze on %s: everyone else, get away!
vadsrijk.z6raid.sterrenbeelden.lied: The Star Song heals the others!
vadsrijk.z6raid.sterrenbeelden.uit_al: This one is already shining: help the others!
vadsrijk.z6raid.sterrenbeelden.venster: One is out! 10 seconds for the other two
vadsrijk.z6raid.sterrenbeelden.zeg.aan: Grrr... we won't let each other go out!
vadsrijk.z6raid.tip.ringeling: Raid tip: JUMP into the pink circle to catch a kicked ring. In the dark: grab star shards and take them to the beacons. Low ring = jump, high ring = sneak.
vadsrijk.z6raid.tip.spiegelvizier: Raid tip: only the real Mirror Vizier sparkles now and then. Turn (right-click) two mirrors to the same image to unmask him.
vadsrijk.z6raid.tip.ster_bultguh: Raid tip: the Humpguh charges along a red lane: step out of it.
vadsrijk.z6raid.tip.ster_pluis: Raid tip: the Little Fluff heals the others: interrupt her song.
vadsrijk.z6raid.tip.sterrenbeelden: Raid tip: the three constellations must go out within 10 seconds of each other. Bring all three low first, and interrupt the Fluff's Star Song!
vadsrijk.z6raid.tip.zandwachter: Raid tip: the Sand Warden only really takes damage once the hourglass is flipped. Two little groups on the two pink plates, at the same time! Then: hit him in the BACK.
vadsrijk.z6raid.verdieping.2: On to floor 2: The Mirror Vizier
vadsrijk.z6raid.verdieping.3: On to floor 3: The Snuffed Constellations
vadsrijk.z6raid.verdieping.4: On to the roof: Duchess Ringaling
vadsrijk.z6raid.wachtzaal.bezet: Occupied: a group of %s is on floor %s (%s group(s) in the queue). Step on the start circle to join the queue.
vadsrijk.z6raid.wachtzaal.plek: You're in the queue: spot %s (the group inside is on floor %s).
vadsrijk.z6raid.wachtzaal.vrij: The tower is free: stand on the golden start circle with 2-10 players.
vadsrijk.z6raid.wachtzaal.welkom: The Waiting Hall of The Star-Snuffing Tower. Stand on the golden start circle with 2-10 players. The exit is the purple arch in the west.
vadsrijk.z6raid.wipe.onder: The tower resets the floor. Wipes: %s. Deep breath, and once more!
vadsrijk.z6raid.zandwachter.fase2: The sand is running out: more pillars!
vadsrijk.z6raid.zandwachter.huid: His sand skin closes up again.
vadsrijk.z6raid.zandwachter.muur: A sand wall! He's extra tough for a moment
vadsrijk.z6raid.zandwachter.onder: A golem of rose sand with an hourglass in his chest
vadsrijk.z6raid.zandwachter.pilaren: %s sand pillars rise up: smash them within 20 seconds!
vadsrijk.z6raid.zandwachter.vuist: Sand Fist on %s: stand in it TOGETHER!
vadsrijk.z6raid.zandwachter.zandloper: The hourglass is running out! Stand on both pink plates AT THE SAME TIME (%s per plate).
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.baken.al: %s is already burning. The stars wink at you.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.baken.nog_niet: It's not this beacon's turn yet. Follow the story first (your tracker shows the way).
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.beloning.wacht.bultgu: (Your humpguh is waiting with Bumpy. It will come to you as soon as humpguhs are in the game.)
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.beloning.wacht.tapijt: (Your carpet has been woven. It will come to you as soon as flying carpets are in the game.)
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.beloning.wacht.uiterl: (This carpet pattern will come to you as soon as flying carpets are in the game.)
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.binnenkort.bondenbord: My board is still empty. The Snuggle Squads are coming soon. Then we'll pin it full of everything.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.binnenkort.kwartierme: The Snuggle Quarter opens soon. Then I'll take you there. Promise.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.bobbeltje: Behind the dune sits Lumpkin, with sand on her hump and a date in her little snout. She hops back with you.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.brief.0: In a gray little tent lies an envelope with a seal: a ring. It says: 'To the Ring Finger.'
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.brief.1: "Madam Duchess. The Empty Lens on the tower works. With every snuffed beacon it drinks more starlight. Your rings are nearly full. The oasis is almost hidden enough to pump dry. Your Knuckle, G."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.brief.2: Below, in elegant handwriting with a little sparkle: "Delightful. Ten toes, ten rings, all the stars. - R."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.bron.slaapt: Mother Spring is asleep, gray and dried up. She mumbles: "...stars... not yet... all of them..."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.epiloog.0: The caravans come back to the Mother Oasis, one by one, with little bells and songs. The water of the Saffron River is rising again.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.epiloog.1: Granny Date makes tea. Lumpkin jumps into the oasis. And in Saffron Gate, in the Paradise Garden, a veiled lady with ten bare toes sits gazing at the stars.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.feest: Lumpkin jumps onto the cake. Everyone cheers. Granny Date sings.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.glans.spiegel: Where Master Gleam stood, there is now a mirror in the shape of a guh. He was never really here.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.grot.schat: The First Caravan's chest opens. Inside is a carpet pattern, and a note.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.kerker.binnen: The Sunken Observatory. It smells of old copper and stardust. You can hear stony snoring.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.klus.dadels: You lift the baskets of dates onto the caravan. They smell sweet.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.klus.tapijten: Carpet Trader Fringe rolls three carpets onto your arms. "Don't drop them. They're a hundred years old."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.klus.water: You fill the waterskins at the fountain. Lumpy sneakily drinks one empty.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.kompas.fallback: Deep in The Sunken Observatory, past the fire bowls and the rings, you find a big gray guh made of starstone. You give him a hug. He glows, very softly, and places the Star Compass in your paws.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.leermeester.binnenkor: My workshop is almost ready. Come back later.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.lens.alle: All five beacons are burning. The Mother Oasis is visible.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.lens.stand: Star Lens: %s of the 5 beacons are burning.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.noria: You tinker with the water wheel. Krrr... krrr-eeek! It's turning again.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.afdingen_karde: "That smells wonderful. May I have a sniff?"
"For forty I'll take two, one for you."
Cardamom blushes. "Have a sniff. It comes from the finest crocuses." What now?
"One for ME? Nobody ever gives me anything..." What do you say?
Cardamom pouts. "That's not how we haggle here, sweetie. Try again. Nicer."
Trader Cardamom: "This little bag of saffron costs fifty coins. Fifty! A bargain."
Cardamom laughs so hard her little spice heaps puff into clouds. "For you: always a discount. Just say Cardamom sent you."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.afdingen_lokum: "What lovely little delights you have there."
"I'll have one, if you have one too."
Delight offers you one. What now?
"About a little ring for a very sweet price."
You chew together. "Mmm. What were we talking about?" What do you say?
Delight slides the Turkish delight away again. "A jeweler doesn't haggle with a penny-pincher." Try again.
Jeweler Delight: "This little ring of saffron gold costs two hundred coins. It fits around a toe."
Delight laughs with powdered sugar on his snout. "For you: the sweet price. Always."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.afdingen_pista: "Then that pot must have belonged to a very sweet grandpa too."
Pistachio strokes his mustache. "Also from my grandpa." What now?
"Then let's do it the way Grandpa did."
Pistachio sniffles. "He was so sweet. He always gave a discount." What do you say?
Pistachio twirls his mustache the wrong way. "Hmpf. Grandpa wouldn't have put it like that." Try again.
Trader Pistachio: "This pot belonged to my grandpa. It's priceless. A hundred coins."
Pistachio gives you a wink and a hug. "Just like Grandpa. Always a discount for you."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.duin.fout: The line between the stars snaps loose. The stars blink patiently. Start again from the first star.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.duin.intro: Mother Spring, louder now: "You follow a humpguh from back to front. The little tail, the back hump, the front hump, and then his sweet head."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.duin.klaar: The constellation The Humpguh shines brightly in the sky!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_1.0.vra: Where does The Little Fluff begin?
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_1.fout: The line between the stars snaps loose. The stars blink patiently. Start again from the first star.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_1.intro: Twinkle: "The Little Fluff is round. Start at the top and go clockwise: top, right, bottom, left."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_1.klaar: The constellation The Little Fluff shines brightly in the sky!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_2.0.vra: Where does The Great Snuggle begin?
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_2.fout: The line between the stars snaps loose. The stars blink patiently. Start again from the first star.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_2.intro: Twinkle: "The Great Snuggle spreads his arms. Left hand, left shoulder, right shoulder, right hand."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_2.klaar: The constellation The Great Snuggle shines brightly in the sky!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_3.0.vra: Where does The Flying Humpguh begin?
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_3.fout: The line between the stars snaps loose. The stars blink patiently. Start again from the first star.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_3.intro: Twinkle: "The Flying Humpguh flies east. Start at his tail in the west, then the wing, and end at his snout in the east."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_3.klaar: The constellation The Flying Humpguh shines brightly in the sky!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_4.0.vra: Where does The Little Crown begin?
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_4.fout: The line between the stars snaps loose. The stars blink patiently. Start again from the first star.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_4.intro: Professor Dust wrote it down: "A cat with a little crown counted the stars. Start at the left point, then the middle one, then the right. Three points. Never enough, he added."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.examen_4.klaar: The constellation The Little Crown shines brightly in the sky!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.lied.0.vraag: Which crystal do you tap first? (La)
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.lied.fout: Pliiing! A wrong note. The crystals giggle. Start the song over.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.lied.intro: The crystals each sing one note. Granny Date hummed the caravan song: "La-la-LAA-la-lo." Low, low, very high, low, and then the very lowest.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.lied.klaar: The crystals sing along with the caravan song, louder and louder. Then the crystal wall slides aside.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.oase.0.vraag: Where does The Mother Palm begin?
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.oase.fout: The line between the stars snaps loose. The stars blink patiently. Start again from the first star.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.oase.intro: Mother Spring, clear as water: "I am the spring. Start at the water, follow the roots up to the trunk, open the crown, and end at the star at the top. That's where I wait."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.oase.klaar: The constellation The Mother Palm shines brightly in the sky!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.oefen.0.vraag: Where does The Little Snuggle begin?
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.oefen.fout: The line between the stars snaps loose. The stars blink patiently. Start again from the first star.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.oefen.intro: Twinkle: "You always draw a little guh head like this: first the left ear, then the right ear, and then the little snout."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.oefen.klaar: The constellation The Little Snuggle shines brightly in the sky!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.palm.0.vraag: Where does The Date Palm begin?
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.palm.fout: The line between the stars snaps loose. The stars blink patiently. Start again from the first star.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.palm.intro: Mother Spring whispers: "A palm grows from the bottom up. Start at the foot, climb up the trunk to the crown, and then let the leaves hang down: first left, then right."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.palm.klaar: The constellation The Date Palm shines brightly in the sky!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.ruine.0.vraag: Where does The Star Guh begin?
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.ruine.fout: The line between the stars snaps loose. The stars blink patiently. Start again from the first star.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.ruine.intro: On the temple wall it's written, half worn away: "The Star Guh begins at his little crown, then his heart, then his left paw and his right paw."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.ruine.klaar: The constellation The Star Guh shines brightly in the sky!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.ster.fout: The line between the stars snaps loose. The stars blink patiently. Start again from the first star.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.ster.goed: You draw a glowing line to %s.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.ster.klaar: The constellation %s shines brightly in the sky!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.ster.lens: It's still light out. You hold the Star Lens to your eye: the sky turns deep blue and full of stars.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.zout.0.vraag: Where does The Little Guh Head begin?
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.zout.fout: The line between the stars snaps loose. The stars blink patiently. Start again at the first star.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.zout.intro: Granny Date hums: "Ears first, left and right. Then the right cheek, the snout in the middle, and the left cheek to close the circle."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.puzzel.zout.klaar: The constellation The Little Guh Head shines bright in the sky!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.ringeling.na.0: "You! My knight! Come here. It's me, Ringaling. The veil? Not everyone knows I'm nice now."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.ringeling.na.1: "You know what I found out when you took my rings? That I didn't miss them. I felt something warm. Chonk. Stolen from nobody."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.ringeling.na.2: "The Emperor has no use for me anymore. I sent him a note. With a little heart on it. He hates little hearts."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.ringeling.na.3: "If you ever go east, to his Fingers: I know where they keep their socks. Do drop by."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.ringeling.voor.0: The veiled lady looks at her toes. Ten bare toes. "Do I know you? Not yet, darling. Not yet."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.aankomst.0: The airship sinks over the pink cliffs. The Silk Wind smells of roses and cinnamon.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.aankomst.1: Below you a gorge opens up, deep and pink. In its walls: doors, little balconies, hanging gardens, lanterns.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.aankomst.2: At the bottom a star-shaped fountain glitters. A caravan of humpguhs is getting ready to go.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.aankomst.3: Welcome to Rose Gorge! Harbormaster Hourglass is already waving his hourglass at you.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.bron.0: You kneel by the gray guh of water and put your paw on her head. She is cold. And as light as a dry sponge.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.bron.1: Granny Date pours the last waterskin over her. The caravan sings. Lumpkin licks her nose.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.bron.2: Mother Spring ripples. She turns blue. Then pink. Then so clear you can see the fish swimming in her tummy.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.bron.3: "Thank you, knight. What a strange dream. Someone drank me dry with a straw made of gray."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.f4.0: Somewhere far in the east. A throne room, gray and silent. A long, thin shadow on a throne that is far too big.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.f4.1: Court Scribe Scribble shuffles forward with a note. It has a little heart on it. His quill trembles.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.f4.2: Scribble: "The Ring Finger... uh... isn't coming. She writes: 'Dear Emperor. I quit. I have seen the stars. Toodle-oo, Ringaling.'"
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.f4.3: Scribble: "And uh... 'Your ring is with the knight.' There's a little drawing too. Of a tongue."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.f4.4: A long gray finger taps the armrest. Tap. Tap. Tap. Then: "Then... I'll... see... myself."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.f4.5: Outside, high above the world, the Eye slowly turns. Away from the Silklands. To the west. To Highchonk.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.luchtspiegeling: The air shimmers. Everywhere you see lakes, palms and towers. None of them are really there.
Granny Date sings the caravan song. The whole caravan sings along. La-la-LAA-la-lo.
Four star rays above you point the same way. Follow them. Not the lakes. The stars.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ontmasker.0: You set the Star Compass on the runner. A thousand mirrors catch the light of the beacons. A glowing path shoots through the hall.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ontmasker.1: Master Gleam stands in every mirror. Even in the mirrors he isn't standing in front of.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ontmasker.2: "What a lovely path. May I borrow it for a moment?" Master Gleam grabs the reflection of the path and rolls it up like a carpet...
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ontmasker.3: ...and his face slides away like a little window. Underneath: a Mika with a mustache made of mirror shards.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ontmasker.4: "Master Gleam, the Mirror Vizier. Knuckle of the Ring Finger. Twenty years I polished. Twenty years! My paws are shiny."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ontmasker.5: He jumps through a mirror and pops out on the roof. After him!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ontsnapt.0: From the East Gate you watch him go: the Mirror Vizier, on a carpet of mirror glass, straight to the east.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ontsnapt.1: Far away, beyond the dunes, stands something that doesn't belong. A gray tower. Golden rings spin around it.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ontsnapt.2: At the top a lens gleams. It sucks the last bit of dusk out of the sky, spiraling inward.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ringeling.0: Ringaling sinks to the floor of her tower. Her rings roll across the stones. Ten. Empty.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ringeling.1: "My TOES! They're so... cold. And so light." She wiggles them. She giggles. Her own giggle startles her.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ringeling.2: You give her a hug. She stiffens. Then she turns pink. First her ears, then her cheeks, then her toes.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ringeling.3: "What is this? It's warm. It's stolen from nobody. It's just... given."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.ringeling.4: She picks up the last ring, the big one, the Emperor's, and puts it in your paw. "You keep that one. I don't want it anymore."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.toren.0: The tower is gray. The grass around its foot is gray. Even the shadow is grayer than a shadow ought to be.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.toren.1: At the top, next to the Empty Lens, stands a lady with a parasol. Ten golden rings gleam on ten toes.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.toren.2: "A knight! How adorable. You lit my stars again. That was very... rude."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.toren.3: She kicks one ring off her toe. It clicks onto the tower gate like a lock.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.toren.4: "That takes at least two, knight. Come back with your little friends. I have tea."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.toren.5: And she dances up the stairs, to the top, to her lens. Her laugh sounds like ten little bells.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.wolkwaltocht.0: Mother Cloudwhale lets out a deep, happy rumble. All of Highchonk shakes. The Queen waves from her balcony.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.wolkwaltocht.1: She swims. Slowly at first, then faster. Clouds stream past her sides. The Cloud Sea slides by beneath you.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.wolkwaltocht.2: In the east a pink stripe looms. Cliffs, as pink as a cheek. Behind them: dunes, domes, palms.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.wolkwaltocht.3: Mother Cloudwhale puffs a little cloud from her blowhole. It forms two words: "This far."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.wolkwaltocht.4: She settles quietly above the strait. At Tail Harbor the lamps come on: Line E to the Silklands is open!
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.zoutkolos.0: The salt cracks. Fissures shoot like lightning across the flats, toward the beacon.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.zoutkolos.1: A giant of caked-together star salt rises up. Its insides glow gray.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.zoutkolos.2: Granny Date whispers: "Don't fight. Run. He's slow, and we are sweet and quick."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.scene.zoutkolos.3: The Salt Colossus stomps to the beacon, sees it burning and stops, confused. You all slip away.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.schat.mesa: On the Table Mesa, under a flat stone, lies a chest of the old Star Guhs. There's a note inside: 'For those who look high enough.'
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.schat.minaret: At the top of the minaret with the guh ears, right between the ears, a little chest is tied fast. Nobody dares go that high. Only knights and pigeons.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.schat.schatkamer: Behind the pillars of the Treasure Room is a nook nobody sees. Except you. There's a chest in it, with a bow on top.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.soep.al: This guh already has soup. He gives you a grateful nod.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.soep.kom: You hand over a bowl of soup. The Unchonked guh turns a tiny bit pink. (%s/3)
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.tablet.tablet_1: We, the Star Guhs, counted the stars. One by one. It took a hundred years and three teapots.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.tablet.tablet_2: When we were done, we handed them out. Every caravan got a star. That way everyone found the way to the water.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.tablet.tablet_3: We built five beacons to hold on to the stars when it was cloudy. Palm, Salt, Ruin, Dune and Oasis.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.tablet.tablet_4: Under the Mother Palm lives Spring. She gives water to those who share. She has never once said no.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.tablet.tablet_5: Then came a cat with a little crown. He counted too. But he did not share. He only counted what he had.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.tablet.tablet_6: He called it: never enough. We called it: sad. Then we went to sleep under the sand.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.tapijtwinkel: I sell ordinary carpets. Flying ones are made by Button, in the Grand Bazaar of Saffron Gate. Patterns for your carpet you'll learn later with Sewing. Or you find them. In the strangest places.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.toren.dicht: The gate of The Star-Snuffing Tower is shut with a ring lock. That takes at least two.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.tuin.water: You water the hanging garden. Rose petals flutter down into the gorge.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.0.0: Something trembles in the fountain water. A voice, very soft, like a droplet: "...here... I'm here..."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.0.2: The water is still again. Twinkle stares at you with big eyes.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.1.0: The beacon flares up! A beam of starlight shoots into the sky, and the Star Lens catches a little star shard.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.1.1: In the beam you briefly see a lake, hidden behind shimmering air. A palm. A gray smudge next to it.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.1.2: A voice, still weak: "Thank you... one star... I can feel it... I am Spring. Mother Spring. Come..."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.2.0: The second beacon burns. Two beams cross above the sand.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.2.1: Mother Spring, a little clearer: "I lie sleeping under my palm. Someone is drinking me dry. With a straw made of gray."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.2.2: "She has rings. Ten. They shine with my stars."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.3.0: Three beams! The star path starts to draw itself: a glowing line to the east.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.3.1: Mother Spring, now like a babbling brook: "You're close. The mirage that hides me is wearing thin."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.3.2: "Beware of those who live in mirrors. Mirrors don't show who you are. Only what you look like."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.4.0: The fourth beacon. Four beams, and the night softly sings along.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.4.1: Mother Spring, clear as a fountain: "One more star. My own star. Bring the caravan. Bring everyone."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.4.2: "I'm so tired, knight. But I'm waking up. I can feel it."
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.5.0: All five beacons are burning! Five beams meet right above the lake.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.5.1: The mirage tears open like a curtain. There lies the Mother Oasis, so blue it hurts your eyes.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.visioen.5.2: And on the shore, under the palm, a big, gray guh of water lies sleeping.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.vondst.z6_zoutkreeft: A little salt crayfish flipped over and caught! (%s/%s)
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.wormelien.zicht: In the distance a dune bursts open. A gigantic pink sandworm with eyelashes rolls through the sand, gray and hungry, and dives back under. Queen Wormelina.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.ziedershuisje: You straighten the little walls of the saltmaker's hut. It stands. Crooked, but it stands.
vadsrijk.z6verhaal.zone6.klaar: The story of the Silklands is complete! The caravans can find the Mother Oasis again. At the top of The Star-Snuffing Tower, Duchess Ringaling is still waiting: that's the raid, for 2 to 10 players.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.aw.fase.onder: Stand in the pink gaps when the rings sweep
vadsrijk.z6wezens.aw.kaatst: The rings deflect your hit! Wait for the golden light.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.aw.nu: The rings are lined up: NOW!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.baas.sterrenguh.onder: An old giant of star stone, gone gray
vadsrijk.z6wezens.baas.wormelien.onder: She swims through the sand, gray and hungry
vadsrijk.z6wezens.dadelaapje.terug: The cheered-up date monkey gives you back %s bronze. Sorry!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.gl.aan: The bowl burns again! (%s of the 4 out)
vadsrijk.z6wezens.gl.donker: He hides in the dark! Light the fire bowls.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.gl.fase2.onder: Two bowls go out, and Lamp Snuffers show up
vadsrijk.z6wezens.gl.weg: Glimmer flees in a puff of smoke. 'My snuffer! The Ring Finger will hear about this!'
vadsrijk.z6wezens.huisdier.gevonden: ✦ A new pet wants to come along: %s! (press P)
vadsrijk.z6wezens.lampendover.gedoofd: Your little light has been snuffed!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.luik.hint.in: An old hatch in the dome (right-click): to The Sunken Observatory
vadsrijk.z6wezens.luik.in: You climb down through the hatch... The Sunken Observatory.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.luik.uit: You climb back up, into Ruin Valley.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.mika.weg.0: This is going in my report!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.mika.weg.1: The Ring Finger will hear about this!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.set.sterrenwacht.6: (6) Starlet: every 20 s your next hit deals +40%% damage
vadsrijk.z6wezens.sg.blij: The Sunken Star Guh glows again! 'Thank you, little traveler. Here: the Star Compass.'
vadsrijk.z6wezens.sg.fase2.onder: A red ring spreading out from him: get close!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.sg.fase3.onder: He scatters more and more star grit
vadsrijk.z6wezens.sg.hart.onder: All beams on his heart: double damage!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.sg.schok: Star shock! Stay close to him!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.sg.telescoop_goed: This one's right! (%s of the 4 aimed)
vadsrijk.z6wezens.sg.wanhoop3: The stars... I can't see them anymore...
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.baas_astrolabiumwa: Hit hardest when the rings are lined up (golden light): then your hit gets all the way through. During a ring sweep: stand in a pink gap.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.baas_glimmertje: He snuffs out the fire bowls. Right-click a dark bowl 2x to light it again. All four out? Then he hides in the dark.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.baas_sterrenguh: Right-click the four telescopes until they are all aimed at his heart (golden beam). Then he glows: double damage!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.baas_wormelien: Keep moving when she dives (standing still = sand fountain). Pink spots = take cover behind a dune. Phase 3: knock the gray salt crust off her back, jump from a dune or shoot it off.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.baas_zoutkolos: Red crack lines = salt waves. Hear a high note? Step out of the purple ring around a crystal, or smash it. Phase 3: look straight at his glowing heart for double damage.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.dadelaapje: He throws dates (red circle) and sometimes pinches coins. Cheer him up and you get it all back.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.duinkruiper: Red cone in front of him = his tail stings. His venom is sticky. Walk around him!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.fennekguh: He hears you from far away and calls his buddy. Red stripe = his leap: step aside.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.gedoofd_sterretje: Three little red circles = star grit. Cheer it up: sometimes it wants to come along with you!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.gierguh: He dives at whoever is LOWEST. Red stripe = dive. Afterwards he sits on the ground for a bit: your chance!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.mika_lampendover: Red cone = his giant snuffer. He makes it dark and snuffs out your Wahoog and Quickpaws.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.mika_ringdrager: Purple circle = he opens a light-catching jar. Walk out of the circle and the beam breaks.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.ruinewachter: A silent statue... until you get close. Big red circle = his stomp: keep your distance.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.spiegelslang: A mirage: there are three, but only one is real. A copy bursts apart when you hit it.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.springpiep: Red circle = he kicks sand: get out of there, or you can't see a thing for a moment. Then he bounces away and back again.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.zandgeestje: Only at night. Purple circle = he pulls you toward him. Step out!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.zandvlooi: They hide in the sand (just two little feelers poking out). Get close and they jump out!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.zoutkreeft: His salt crust blocks hits from the front. From BEHIND he's soft: walk around him!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.tip.zoutslang: She swims through the rocks and comes for NOISE: running and hitting. Red stripe = that's where she pops out!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.wm.blij: Queen Wormelina is pink again... she yawns, and falls asleep in the warm sand.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.wm.duikt: She dives under! Keep moving, or you'll get a sand fountain!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.wm.fase2.onder: Take cover on the pink spots!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.wm.fase3.onder: Knock the gray salt crust off her back!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.wm.korst: A gray salt crust on her back! Jump at it from a dune, or shoot it off.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.wm.korst_eerst: The salt crust protects her! Knock the crust off first.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.wm.korst_weg: The crust is off! She's dazed for a moment: hit her now!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.wm.onder: She's under the sand! Wait until she comes up.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.wm.schuil: She's gulping sand! Take cover on a pink spot!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.zk.fase2.onder: High note = purple ring: step out!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.zk.fase3.onder: Look straight at his heart: double damage!
vadsrijk.z6wezens.zk.gloeit: His heart glows! Look at it while you hit (even better with the Star Lens).
vadsrijk.z6wezens.zk.kristallen: He throws singing crystals! Listen for the high note.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.zk.weg: The Salt Colossus crumbles into glittering salt.
vadsrijk.z6wezens.zoutslang.onder: She swims through the rock... wait until she comes up!
